About Toolio | Retail Planning Software for Mid-Market & Enterprise Retailers

Toolio is a merchandise planning platform from mid-market to enterprise retailers. Through modern technology, a customer-obsessed team and a community built for planners and merchants, we make sophisticated retail planning easy and accessible.

Toolio is headquartered in New York with offices in Istanbul and customers across the US and UK. Our team brings decades of experience from Walmart, NetSuite, Facebook, Microsoft and McKinsey, paired with engineers who build intuitive, data-driven technology. We’re backed by top VCs, Stanford professors and retail industry executives.

From data to decision making across the company to interpersonal relationships, being open and direct drives our day to day interactions. We ensure we are proactively documenting how our departments operate so that anyone can step in and easily understand or quickly get the information they need to move forward.

We are a young growing company with room for improvement. Don’t hesitate to call out errors or suggest changes that stand to propel us forward. We love to see Toolions take the initiative while pushing themselves and the business to new levels.

Toolions are smart about how to get the most out of an investment. Whether it’s an investment of time or money, we’re always asking if we can reduce the input or get more output. We invest in systems and processes to get outsized returns.

However, we don’t want these achievements to come at the expense of overall health and well-being. A rocket ship that loses its propulsion will fall back to earth. Therefore, Toolions need to manage the right balance of short term success with longevity because we want this company around for the long-run.
